# theOET

> Story-based English learning platform for ESL/EAL children and online teaching careers.

theOET provides comprehensive resources for English language learners aged 3-8 and supports teachers in building successful online ESL teaching careers. The platform combines printable story-based activities with professional training and membership communities.

## Key Topics

- ESL/EAL learning
- Story-based learning
- Print and Play Club
- Printable resources
- Early literacy
- Children ages 3-8
- Online ESL teaching
- Homeschool resources
- theOET Training
- Language activities
- English learning
- Free printables
- Membership club
- Teaching careers

## Learning Programs

- [the Print and Play Club](https://theoet.com/the-print-and-play-club): Story-based English learning membership club for ESL/EAL children at home
- [Free Resource Library for ESL Learners](https://theoet.com/free-resource-library): Free printable ESL resources and story-based activities for ages 3-8

## Teacher Training & Careers

- [theOET Training](https://teachers.theoet.com): Professional training program helping teachers start and succeed in online ESL teaching careers
